attractions.name: Phobjikha (Gangtey) Valley
attractions.description: Bowl-shaped valley and wildlife preserve, winter home of the black-necked crane. Around 600 cranes migrate from Tibet between November and March. Other wildlife includes muntjac, sambar, serow and yak.

attractions.name: Gangtey Goemba
attractions.description: 17th-century Nyingma monastery on a hill overlooking the valley, an excellent example of Tibetan architecture. The prayer hall (tshokhang) has eight great pillars. Built in 1613 by Pema Lingpa's grandson and reincarnation, fulfilling Pema Lingpa's prophecy. Nearby Kuenzang Chholing is where monks meditate for three years, three months and three days.

attractions.name: Gangtey Nature Trail
attractions.description: Shortest and one of the most beautiful nature trails in Bhutan, from the hilltop above Gangtey Goemba downhill through flower meadows to Semchubara village and through forest into the open valley.

season_notes.tip: Black-necked cranes migrate from Tibet to the valley between November and March
